preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N and all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every string in the output list has length N and contains only '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '1') >= sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '0') for i in range(len(s))) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: For every string in the output, every prefix has at least as many 1s as 0s.
The output list is sorted in decreasing lexicographical order.
The output list contains no duplicate strings.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(s) == N and all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '1') >= sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '0') for i in range(len(s))) for s in return_value) and all(not (len(s) == N and all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '1') >= sum(1 for c in s[:i+1] if c == '0') for i in range(len(s))) for s in [''.join(format(i, f'0{N}b') for i in range(2**N)] if s not in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly all N-bit binary strings satisfying the prefix condition, with no omissions or extras.
